Frequently asked question

Here's everything you need to know to get started, manage your account, and troubleshoot the most frequent issues.

What is this platform used for? −
This platform is designed to help users manage their work more efficiently by offering tools that simplify organization, communication, and collaboration.
How do I manage my account? +
You can manage your account from the Settings panel. Update your profile, billing, team members, and permissions all from one place.
Can I request a refund? +
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Contact our support team and we'll process your refund promptly.
Can I switch plans at any time? +
Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. No penalties for switching.
How do I reset my password? +
Click "Forgot password" on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send a reset link within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.
Is my data safe on this platform? +
Yes. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never sell or share it with third parties.
How do I contact customer support? +
You can reach our support team via live chat, email, or by submitting a ticket from your dashboard. Growth plan users get priority response within 4 hours.
What are the accepted payment methods? +
We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, UPI, and bank transfers for annual enterprise contracts. All payments are PCI-compliant and secured.
